evaluation: 2018 observed development; no new independent test claim
primary: TP at top10 each day, not global yearly top3650
selection: Fixed final epoch and mean probabilities across all three declared seeds; no best-seed selection
positive_evidence: B2 or B3 must beat B1 in mean ensemble daily TP and paired daily 95% interval lower bound > 0; B3 must also beat B3_shuffled for semantic attribution
phase2_admission: Proceed to combined semantic-history experiments only with positive semantic evidence; independent loss/history mechanisms can be delivered as tested research primitives without claiming results
scope_limit: Only pretrained-category-encoding effect on IBM synthetic development data; source vocabulary and pretrained model postdate transactions; not historical deployment or new future generalization proof
